text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I feel as light as if I have sprouted 
wings. I believe I can show you a truly 
fulfilling race~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course, feet firmly on the ground. 
Solemnly, unswayed, moving forward with 
grace—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Because I, too, am a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well then, I shall be on my way~♪
